user.title: Find your school
user.description: Enter part of the school name, the city or the school number.

credentials.title: Sign in to {school}
credentials.description: Use the same user name and password as on Schulportal Hessen. The integration only reads data.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {school} was rejected. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Schulportal Hessen could not be reached.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check school, user name and password.
error.no_schools_found: No school found for this search.
error.too_many_results: Too many results. Please be more specific.

data_description.first_hours: The 'Cancellation in first periods' sensor is on if any of periods 1 to N is cancelled.

timetable_structure.title: Timetable no longer recognised
timetable_structure.description: The portal returns the timetable but the integration finds no lessons in it. The portal may have changed, or your timetable really is empty. If you expect lessons, please report it as a GitHub issue (without passwords or personal data).
